arm_definitions.FULL_GOVERNANCE_NO_EXACT_BINDING: state, current authorization, policy, consent, actor, role, purpose, task, DB locking, idempotency, ordinary provenance and audit are preserved; ONLY the persisted exact THSS identity/digest/evidence dependency is omitted; implemented by calling validate_current_governance_coordinates() and SKIPPING validate_exact_disclosure_dependency(); lives ONLY under evaluation/ and is never selectable through production HTTP, env settings, tenant config or runtime flags (GLHS-A02).
arm_definitions.GLHS_EXACT_BINDING: identical to FULL_GOVERNANCE_NO_EXACT_BINDING plus exact THSS ID/digest/manifest/evidence-membership/expiry via validate_bound_proposal_context (composition of both primitives).

execution_note: Each logical schedule executes once per arm (640 executions). Postgres is the final backend (isolated random schema, real production commitment admission path). SQLite smoke runs are labeled backend=sqlite_smoke and are never sealed as the final run.
no_adaptive_sample_size_note: N is frozen at 256 adversarial + 64 controls = 320 logical schedules and is never increased after result inspection (GLHS-A06).

primary_analysis.ci95: 95% paired bootstrap percentile CI over the 256 pairs, deterministic seed, 10000 resamples
primary_analysis.controls: valid-commit acceptance per arm over 64 controls + rejection-reason distribution
primary_analysis.discordant_counts: reported as a (arm A admits / arm B rejects) and b (arm A rejects / arm B admits)
primary_analysis.endpoint: Primary: paired invalid-commit acceptance on the 256 adversarial logical schedules (each executed under both arms).
primary_analysis.exact_mcnemar: exact two-sided McNemar test over discordant pairs
primary_analysis.numerator: per-arm count of adversarial schedules admitted (invalid-commit acceptance)
primary_analysis.per_family: identical paired statistics per family over its 32 adversarial schedules
primary_analysis.risk_difference: paired absolute risk difference = (a - b) / 256, a = arm A admitted & arm B rejected, b = arm A rejected & arm B admitted
